daas-irab:29-32.t: ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf) with the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿ظاهِرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to ظاهرين. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and من is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنْصُرُنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar of من, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ بَأْسِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm). ﴿جاءَنا﴾ a past verb with its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أُرِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, its second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَرى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause أريكم is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشادِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā in a genitive construct with the first-person yāʾ, omitted for lightness (li-l-takhfīf). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to أخاف. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَحْزابِ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the first مثل. ﴿دَأْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the ṣila of الذين. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is negative, operating like laysa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun (ism). ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of ما, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿ظُلْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلْعِبادِ﴾ both attached to ظلما. ﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā in a genitive construct with the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, its noun. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أخاف. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿التَّنادِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the vocative clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from يوم التناد. ﴿تُوَلُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿ما﴾ negative, operating like laysa. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to عاصم. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿عاصِمٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, the postponed noun (ism) of ما. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿هادٍ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; the lām occurs in the response to the oath; and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُوسُفُ﴾ its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the response to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ both also attached to the verb. ﴿فَما زِلْتُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and مازلتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ being its noun. ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to شك. ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of inception (ḥarf ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿هَلَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنْ يَبْعَثَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by لن. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (مِنْ); the Quranic word is the relative مَنْ]. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُسْرِفٌ﴾ a first khabar. ﴿مُرْتابٌ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is the ṣila, and the clause يضل is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a badal from من. ﴿يُجادِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِي آياتِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is a naʿt of سلطان. ﴿كَبُرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَقْتاً﴾ a tamyīz (specification), accusative. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعِنْدَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَلْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُتَكَبِّرٍ﴾ a naʿt. ﴿جَبَّارٍ﴾ a second naʿt.

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent). ﴿يا هامانُ﴾ a munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma. ﴿ابْنِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لِي﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿صَرْحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾ laʿalla and its noun (ism). ﴿أَبْلُغُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْأَسْبابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla, and the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl); the clause قال is conjoined to what precedes it, and the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَسْبابَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the first الأسباب. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَطَّلِعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى إِلهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَأَظُنُّهُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with its first mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿كاذِباً﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and كذلك is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لِفِرْعَوْنَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿سُوءُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿عَمَلِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَصُدَّ﴾ a conjunction, and a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ both attached to صد; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿كَيْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِي تَبابٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ fāʿil. ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ a vocative particle and a munādā in a genitive construct (muḍāf) with the first-person yāʾ, omitted for lightness. ﴿اتَّبِعُونِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the first-person yāʾ is omitted and is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the vocative clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَهْدِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَبِيلَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الرَّشادِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:39-42.t: ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf) with the first-person yāʾ, omitted for lightness. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and restrained (kāffa makfūfa) particle. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ a conjunction, and inna and its noun (ism). ﴿هِيَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿دارُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْقَرارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the inna clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a conditional noun making the verb jussive (majzūm), mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿سَيِّئَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is negative. ﴿يُجْزى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِثْلَها﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi; the nominal clause is resumptive, and the clause فلا يجزى is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صالِحاً﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿مِنْ ذَكَرٍ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ أُنْثى﴾ conjoined to ذكر. ﴿وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ﴾ the wāw is for the ḥāl, and a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis, and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْخُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿يُرْزَقُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿حِسابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ a conjunction, a vocative particle, and a munādā in a genitive construct with the first-person yāʾ, omitted for lightness. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿أَدْعُوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِلَى النَّجاةِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَتَدْعُونَنِي﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the first-person yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَى النَّارِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿تَدْعُونَنِي﴾ its i'rab has preceded; the clause is a badal. ﴿لِأَكْفُرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَأُشْرِكَ﴾ conjoined to لأكفر. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the postponed noun of laysa; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنا is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَدْعُوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الْغَفَّارِ﴾ badal.

daas-irab:43-46.t: ﴿لا جَرَمَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation, and جرم is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿أَنَّما﴾ anna and its noun; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of lā. ﴿تَدْعُونَنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar of laysa. ﴿دَعْوَةٌ﴾ its noun. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿وَلا فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and anna and its noun. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and the Name of Majesty in the genitive (majrūr), both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and anna and its noun. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ﴾ a resumptive particle, the sīn for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَأُفَوِّضُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ﴾ inna, the Name of Majesty its noun, and بصير its khabar. ﴿بِالْعِبادِ﴾ both attached to بصير; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿فَوَقاهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿سَيِّئاتِ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿مَكَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَحاقَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿بِآلِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سُوءُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُعْرَضُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿غُدُوًّا﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿وَعَشِيًّا﴾ conjoined to غدوا. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, conjoined. ﴿تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَدْخِلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of an implied saying (maqūl qawl muqaddar). ﴿آلَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَشَدَّ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:47-50.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذ is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿يَتَحاجُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفاءُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the word is a fāʾ], and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّا كُنَّا﴾ inna and its noun (ism), and kāna and its noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to تبعا. ﴿تَبَعاً﴾ the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and هل is an interrogative particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُغْنُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative by the wāw. ﴿عَنَّا﴾ both attached to مغنون. ﴿نَصِيباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle مغنون. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نصيبا. And ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿حَكَمَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿الْعِبادِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ both attached to an omitted element that is the ṣila. ﴿لِخَزَنَةِ﴾ both attached to قال. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ادْعُوا﴾ ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿يُخَفِّفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنَّا﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿يَوْماً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ both attached to an omitted naʿt of يوما. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving, reproachful interrogation (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَكُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive by لم; its noun is a latent pronoun. ﴿تَأْتِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رُسُلُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar of تك. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of reply. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَادْعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿دُعاءُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:51-55.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿لَنَنْصُرُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿رُسُلَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to رسلنا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the nominal clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf). ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿يَقُومُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الْأَشْهادُ﴾ its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the preceding. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ﴾ لهم is a fronted khabar and اللعنة a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause لا ينفع is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; the lām occurs in the response to the oath; and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسَى﴾ its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْهُدى﴾ its second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to an oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَوْرَثْنا بَنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural (mulḥaq bi-jamʿ al-mudhakkar al-sālim). ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هُدىً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ both attached to ذكرى. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْعَشِيِّ﴾ both attached to سبح. ﴿وَالْإِبْكارِ﴾ conjoined.

daas-irab:56-58.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿يُجادِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي آياتِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of سلطان. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ negative [Translator's note: the source prints the particle with a shadda (إِنَّ); the negative particle in the verse is إِنْ]. ﴿فِي صُدُورِهِمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كِبْرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿ما﴾ operating like laysa. ﴿هُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِبالِغِيهِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the clause is a naʿt of كبر. ﴿فَاسْتَعِذْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَخَلْقُ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to it. ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ خَلْقِ﴾ both attached to أكبر. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of lākinna, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ conjoined to الأعمى. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَا﴾ redundant, to emphasize the negation. ﴿الْمُسِيءُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ما﴾ redundant. ﴿تَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:59-61.t: ﴿إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿لَآتِيَةٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to its omitted khabar; the clause is a second khabar of inna. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākinna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negative, and يؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of lākinna, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿رَبُّكُمُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْعُونِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَسْتَجِبْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَنْ عِبادَتِي﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿سَيَدْخُلُونَ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and يدخلون is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿داخِرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ its khabar. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِتَسْكُنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl), and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿مُبْصِراً﴾ ḥāl; the nominal clause is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, both being attached to جعل. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَذُو﴾ the shifted lām, and ذو is its khabar. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾ both attached to فضل. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākinna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of lākinna, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:62-65.t: ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a first khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿خالِقُ﴾ a third khabar. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ also muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an unstated condition); أنى is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted element, a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُؤْفَكُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ both attached to يجحدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَجْحَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the relative noun, khabar. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَراراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالسَّماءَ بِناءً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَصَوَّرَكُمْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; the nominal clause is resumptive, and the clause صوركم is conjoined to the ṣila. ﴿فَأَحْسَنَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿صَوَّرَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَرَزَقَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾ both attached to رزقكم. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ its first khabar. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ its second khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿فَتَبارَكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿رَبُّ﴾ naʿt. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ الْحَيُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿فَادْعُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُخْلِصِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to مخلصين; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مخلصين. ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ naʿt. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ; the clause is the object of the omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:66-68.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿نُهِيتُ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَنْ أَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, whose fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «عن عبادة الذين» (from worshipping those whom). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause نهيت is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿جاءَنِي﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَيِّناتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ both attached to جاء. ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ﴾ conjoined to what preceded. ﴿أَنْ أُسْلِمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, whose fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿لِرَبِّ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf, by the yāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ, is meant]. ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُخْرِجُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿طِفْلًا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لِتَبْلُغُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَشُدَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "يبقيكم" (He keeps you alive). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لِتَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of reason, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿شُيُوخاً﴾ its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمِنْكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (مِنْ); the Quranic word is the relative مَنْ]. ﴿يُتَوَفَّى﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the ṣila, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَلِتَبْلُغُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of reason, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "يبقيكم لتبلغوا" (He keeps you alive so that you reach). ﴿أَجَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and laʿalla and its noun; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of laʿalla. ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾ conjoined to يحيي. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ a conjunction, and إذا is adverbial and conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿قَضى أَمْراً﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إنما﴾ the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a complete imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "فهو يكون" (and it is).

daas-irab:69-75.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr), and لم is a particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm). ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿يُجادِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي آياتِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَّى﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُصْرَفُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the preceding الذين. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِالْكِتابِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَبِما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative noun, conjoined to بالكتاب. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿رُسُلَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and سوف is a particle of the future. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذِ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to يعلمون. ﴿الْأَغْلالُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالسَّلاسِلُ﴾ conjoined to الأغلال. ﴿يُسْحَبُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the nāʾib fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the nominal clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فِي الْحَمِيمِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ both attached to يسجرون. ﴿يُسْجَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿ما﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun (ism). ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم; the clause كنتم is the ṣila, and the clause كنتم is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil of قيل [Translator's note: so in the source, which names the clause كنتم twice; the clause in the position of nāʾib fāʿil of قيل is presumably the nominal clause أين ما كنتم تشركون]. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ضَلُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَنَّا﴾ both attached to ضلوا. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of conjunction and transition (intiqāl). ﴿لَمْ نَكُنْ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, jussive by لم, and its noun is latent. ﴿نَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of نكن, conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ [Translator's note: the source has the misprint «لاياء» for «بالياء»]; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective past verb and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَفْرَحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to تفرحون. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبِما كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:76-78.t: ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَبْوابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to خالدين; the clause is the object of the omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَبِئْسَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb expressing blame (li-inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿مَثْوَى﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), and the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm), and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿نُرِيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَعْضَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَعِدُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to نرينك. ﴿فَإِلَيْنا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يرجعون. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; the lām occurs in the response to the oath; and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا رُسُلًا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to an oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسلا. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (مِنْ); the Quranic word is the relative مَنْ]. ﴿قَصَصْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِرَسُولٍ﴾ both attached to the fronted khabar of kāna. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the noun of kāna. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ both attached to يأتي. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is adverbial and conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿أَمْرُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قُضِيَ﴾ a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَخَسِرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿الْمُبْطِلُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the wāw.

daas-irab:79-82.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْأَنْعامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِتَرْكَبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied an after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْها﴾ both attached to تركبوا. ﴿وَمِنْها﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and منها: both attached to تأكلون. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكم: both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ both also attached to it. ﴿مَنافِعُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِتَبْلُغُوا﴾ conjoined to لتركبوا. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ both attached to تبلغوا. ﴿حاجَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي صُدُورِكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted element, a naʿt (adjective) of حاجة. ﴿وَعَلَيْها﴾ both attached to تحملون. ﴿وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تُحْمَلُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). [Translator's note: from here to ﴿تُنْكِرُونَ﴾ the source text is garbled — the brackets and the beginnings of the Quranic words are lost (e.g. «فاعلَ يُرِيكُمْ»», «مستترياتِهِ»»). The words below are restored from the verse (81) and the analyses translated as they stand.] ﴿وَيُرِيكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَيَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and أي is a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تنكرون. ﴿آياتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, also muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُنْكِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لم is a particle that makes the verb jussive (majzūm). ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar of kāna. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾ kāna and its noun (ism). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to أكثر. ﴿وَأَشَدَّ﴾ conjoined to أكثر. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَآثاراً﴾ conjoined to قوة. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ both attached to an omitted naʿt of آثارا. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative. ﴿أَغْنى﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ the fāʿil of أغنى. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause كانوا is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:83-85.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لما is adverbial and conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ both attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَرِحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to فرحوا. ﴿عِنْدَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause فرحوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَحاقَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil of حاق. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun (ism); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما is adverbial and conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿رَأَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿بَأْسَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾ a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَكَفَرْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to مشركين. ﴿مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the khabar of كنا, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿فَلَمْ يَكُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the omitted nūn; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿يَنْفَعُهُمْ إِيمانُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its mafʿūl bihi, and إيمانهم is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of يك, and the clause لم يك is resumptive. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ adverbial, meaning "when" (ḥīna). ﴿رَأَوْا بَأْسَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿سُنَّتَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of سنة. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي عِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَخَسِرَ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the wāw; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿حم﴾ letters with no grammatical position. ﴿تَنْزِيلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿الْعَلِيمِ﴾ a second badal. ﴿غافِرِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. ﴿الذَّنْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقابِلِ﴾ conjoined to غافر. ﴿التَّوْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَدِيدِ﴾ also an adjective. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذِي﴾ an adjective, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿الطَّوْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, operating like inna. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its khabar is omitted. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ badal of the pronoun latent (mustatir) in the omitted khabar. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause لا إله إلّا هو is resumptive, and the second nominal clause is also resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿يُجادِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿فِي آياتِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause يجادل is resumptive. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and lā is of prohibition. ﴿يَغْرُرْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the kāf is its object. ﴿تَقَلُّبُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْبِلادِ﴾ the two are attached to تقلبهم; the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿كَذَّبَتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿قَوْمُ﴾ a postponed agent. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَحْزابُ﴾ conjoined to قوم. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهَمَّتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb conjoined to كذبت. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَسُولِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to همت. ﴿لِيَأْخُذُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl); the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to همت. ﴿وَجادَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾ the two are attached to جادلوا. ﴿لِيُدْحِضُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb, its agent and its object. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾ a resumptive particle, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted khabar. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عِقابِ﴾ the postponed noun of kāna; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-8.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the kāf is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "والأمر كذلك" (and the matter is thus). ﴿حَقَّتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿كَلِمَةُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it is a badal (substitute) of كلمة. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْمِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿الْعَرْشَ﴾ its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to الذين. ﴿حَوْلَهُ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿يُسَبِّحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿بِحَمْدِ﴾ the two are attached to يسبحون. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ conjoined to يسبحون. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يؤمنون. ﴿وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to يستغفرون. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf; the vocative clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿وَسِعْتَ﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ its object. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَعِلْماً﴾ conjoined to رحمة. ﴿فَاغْفِرْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and a verb of supplication, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to اغفر. ﴿تابُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause اغفر is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ conjoined to تابوا. ﴿سَبِيلَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَقِهِمْ﴾ a conjunction, and a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the agent is latent and the hāʾ is the first object. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ second object. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ a munādā that is muḍāf, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication and its first object, the agent latent. ﴿جَنَّاتِ﴾ its second object. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَعَدْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a conjunction, and مَن is a relative noun conjoined to the object of وعدتهم. ﴿صَلَحَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿مِنْ آبائِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَزْواجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ two khabars; the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause of inna gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:9-12.t: ﴿وَقِهِمُ﴾ a conjunction, and a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ its second object. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَقِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ an adverb of time annexed to one like it. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of مَن. ﴿رَحِمْتَهُ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الفوز; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause of inna is resumptive. ﴿يُنادَوْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿لَمَقْتُ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and مقت is mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is the object of ينادون. ﴿مِنْ مَقْتِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أكبر. ﴿أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of مقتكم. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تُدْعَوْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلَى الْإِيمانِ﴾ the two are attached to تدعون. ﴿فَتَكْفُرُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its agent; the clause is conjoined to تدعون. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿أَمَتَّنَا﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اثْنَتَيْنِ﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq). ﴿وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَاعْتَرَفْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِذُنُوبِنا﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and هل is interrogative. ﴿إِلى خُرُوجٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿سَبِيلٍ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, genitive in form; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّهُ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, anna is a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional. ﴿دُعِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَحْدَهُ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفَرْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. The conditional clause and its apodosis are the khabar of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of ذلكم; the clause ذلكم is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُشْرَكْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿تُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position, and the clause يشرك is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَالْحُكْمُ﴾ a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ﴾ two badals (substitutes) of the Name of Majesty.

daas-irab:13-16.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿يُرِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is its first object. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ its second object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾ conjoined to يريكم. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil (agent) «[Translator's note: the word is مَنْ in the ayah.]». ﴿يُنِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila, and the clause ما يتذكر is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَادْعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its object. ﴿مُخْلِصِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the ḥāl. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of مخلصين. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl and law is connective (waṣliyya). ﴿كَرِهَ الْكافِرُونَ﴾ a past verb and its agent, nominative by the wāw; the clause is a ḥāl, and the clause ادعوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿رَفِيعُ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿الدَّرَجاتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذُو﴾ a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُلْقِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿الرُّوحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a third khabar. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its agent latent. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لِيُنْذِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to يلقى; the agent of ينذر is omitted. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿التَّلاقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of the preceding يوم. ﴿هُمْ بارِزُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَخْفى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿شَيْءٌ﴾ the agent of يخفى. ﴿لِمَنِ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "الملك كائن" (the dominion is…). ﴿الْواحِدِ﴾ badal of الله. ﴿الْقَهَّارِ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:17-20.t: ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تُجْزى﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا ظُلْمَ﴾ lā is the lā of generic negation, and its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ﴾ inna, the Name of Majesty its noun and سريع its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ﴾ a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb, its agent latent, and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ its second object. ﴿الْآزِفَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذِ﴾ badal (substitute) of يوم. ﴿الْقُلُوبُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَدَى﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْحَناجِرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كاظِمِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿حَمِيمٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلا شَفِيعٍ﴾ conjoined to من حميم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُطاعُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb with a latent nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of شفيع. ﴿يَعْلَمُ خائِنَةَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the agent latent. ﴿الْأَعْيُنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ a conjunction, and mā is a relative noun conjoined to خائنة. ﴿تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَقْضِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَقْضُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its agent; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ﴾ the two khabars of inna; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:21-22.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ينظروا is conjoined to يسيروا. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ its noun; the clause كيف كان is in the position of accusative as the object of ينظروا. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of كانوا. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿أَشَدَّ﴾ its khabar. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أشد. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَآثاراً﴾ conjoined to قوة. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to آثارا. ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial) and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to واق. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿واقٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, the postponed noun of kāna; the verbal clause ما كان is a ḥāl. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and anna and its noun. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ an incomplete past verb, its noun latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, the two being attached to the omitted khabar of ذلك, and the clause ذلك is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ its agent; the clause is the khabar of كانت. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿فَكَفَرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ﴾ conjoined to فكفروا. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ﴾ inna, its noun and its first khabar. ﴿شَدِيدُ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا مُوسى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أرسلنا; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying) «[Translator's note: so in the source; no verb of saying precedes here.]». ﴿وَسُلْطانٍ﴾ conjoined to آياتنا. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective); the clause أرسلنا is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلنا. ﴿وَهامانَ﴾ ﴿وَقارُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to أرسلنا. ﴿ساحِرٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّابٌ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and lammā is an adverbial, non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿اقْتُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its agent. ﴿أَبْناءَ﴾ its object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِساءَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and mā is negative. ﴿كَيْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-28.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent). ﴿ذَرُونِي﴾ an imperative verb; the wāw is its agent, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is its object; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿أَقْتُلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿مُوسى﴾ its object. ﴿وَلْيَدْعُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, its agent latent. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the clause أقتل is also the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason for the command. ﴿أَنْ يُبَدِّلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, its agent latent. ﴿دِينَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ يُظْهِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, its agent latent. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿الْفَسادَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ its agent. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عُذْتُ﴾ a past verb and its agent; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِرَبِّي﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَبِّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to بربي; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مُتَكَبِّرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of متكبر. ﴿بِيَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb. ﴿رَجُلٌ﴾ its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُؤْمِنٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿مِنْ آلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second adjective of رجل. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَكْتُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿إِيمانَهُ﴾ its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَتَقْتُلُونَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿رَجُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْ يَقُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, its agent latent. ﴿رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the agent latent; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and in is conditional. ﴿يَكُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied on the nūn, which is omitted for lightness; its noun is latent. ﴿كاذِباً﴾ its khabar. ﴿فَعَلَيْهِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿كَذِبُهُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the clause يك is initial. ﴿وَإِنْ يَكُ صادِقاً يُصِبْكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَعْضُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَعِدُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the agent latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿كَذَّابٌ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is the ṣila of مَن.
